GameMates is a desktop app for gamers who want to keep track of the friends they play with across different games.
It helps users store each friend's contact details, the games they play, their in-game usernames, and game-specific notes such as roles, servers, preferred weapons, or play styles.
GameMates is optimized for users who prefer a fast command-line workflow while still having a visual desktop interface.
* Add, edit, delete, list, and filter friends.
* Keep your own profile in a separate Myself card.
* Store optional contact details such as phone numbers and email addresses.
* Add games to each friend with their in-game username.
* List or filter friends by name or game.
* View, filter, and delete game entries for each friend.
For detailed documentation, see the [GameMates Product Website](https://ay2627s1-cs2103t-w14-3.github.io/tp/).

`ArgumentTokenizer` lets users wrap a whole value in double quotes. Prefixes inside the quotes are literal text,
* A value is quoted when its first character after trimming is `"`. Its content is trimmed like any value.
* In any value, `\"` is a literal `"`. Only the backslash right before a quote is removed, so `\\"` gives `\"`.
* A quoted value cannot end with `\` right before the closing quote, since `\"` is read as a literal `"`.
Users add a space before the closing quote instead, which trimming removes.
* A bare `"` in an unquoted value, a missing closing quote or text after the closing quote throws a `ParseException`.
Each case has its own message.
* Only straight quotes `"` are supported. Other quotes such as curly quotes `“ ”` do not start or end a quoted value.
They are kept as normal text.
* The preamble is not parsed for quotes.

The list validates this invariant on addition, replacement and bulk replacement.

`Game.isSameGame` compares game names. Full game equality also compares usernames and metadata.

Full game equality alone does not enforce this rule, so `JsonAdaptedFriend` also validates game-name uniqueness during loading.

## Keep your gaming friends in one place
GameMates is a desktop app for gamers who want to remember who they play with and the usernames their friends use
across games. Manage friends with typed commands and check their details in a visual panel alongside the friend list.
Your friends and game entries are saved locally for your next session.
![GameMates showing a friend and their games beside the friend list](images/Ui.png)
* Add friends with just a name, optional phone/email details and tags; edit or delete them later.
* Find friends by name or list friends who play a particular game.
* View a friend's or your own games and in-game usernames, or show only one matching game with `gamelist`.
* Add or remove games for a friend or your own profile using `gameadd` and `gamedel`.
* Edit your own profile using `edit myself`, keep it separate from friends, and back up your local data file.
For example, `list g/Valorant` lists Valorant players. Then `gamelist 1 g/Valorant` shows the first displayed
player's Valorant card without changing the filtered friend list.
Add roles, levels and other game details with `gameadd 1 g/Valorant u/player m/Role:Support m/Level:20`.
Metadata appears below the username in each game card. See the [User Guide](UserGuide.html#adding-a-game-gameadd).
